title.zh: 将三宝颜市从Camins省长路与退伍军人大道交叉口至利科莫的国道命名为Maria Clara L. Lobregat公路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the National Road From Intersection of Governor Camins Road and Veterans Avenue up to Licomo in the City of Zamboanga to Maria Clara L. Lobregat Highway
title.orig: An Act Naming the National Road From Intersection of Governor Camins Road and Veterans Avenue up to Licomo in the City of Zamboanga to Maria Clara L. Lobregat Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9270_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The portion of the national road starting from the intersection of Governor Camins Road and Veterans Avenue up to Licomo in the City of Zamboanga is hereby named Maria Clara L. Lobregat Highway.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
